question: Take the genes with a validated unfavourable prognosis in liver hepatocellular carcinoma (TCGA) that are also tissue enriched in liver at the RNA level. For those genes give a bar chart of how many belong to each protein class, a scatter of liver nTPM against the prognostic p-value with gene labels and both axes on a log scale, a heatmap of their nTPM across liver, kidney, pancreas, colon and lung, and the table behind the figures.

tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"Gene\",\"Gene name\",\"Cancer\",\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" FROM cancer_prognostic_data WHERE Cancer ILIKE '%Liver%' AND \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" IS NOT NULL AND \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" <> '' LIMIT 20"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"Gene\",\"RNA tissue specificity\",\"RNA tissue specific nTPM\",\"Protein class\" FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"RNA tissue specificity\" ILIKE '%enriched%' LIMIT 10"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT DISTINCT Tissue FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE Tissue ILIKE '%liver%' OR Tissue ILIKE '%kidney%' OR Tissue ILIKE '%pancrea%' OR Tissue ILIKE '%colon%' OR Tissue ILIKE '%lung%'"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH p AS (SELECT \"Gene\",\"Gene name\", \"Protein class\" FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"RNA tissue specificity\"='Tissue enriched'), q AS (SELECT \"Gene\",\"Gene name\", TRY_CAST(\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" AS DOUBLE) pval FROM cancer_prognostic_data WHERE Cancer='Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma (TCGA)' AND TRY_CAST(\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL), e AS (SELECT \"Gene\",\"Gene name\",TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE) liver_ntpm FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE Tissue='liver') SELECT q.\"Gene name\" gene,q.pval,e.liver_ntpm,p.\"Protein class\" FROM q JOIN p USING (\"Gene\") JOIN e USING (\"Gene\") ORDER BY q.pval"}
